primary_products.value: Stock photos; stock videos; illustrations and vector art; CGI and 3D visuals; generative AI tools

quotes.quote: The images and videos you'll find in our Creative library reflect the human creativity, expertise, and craftsmanship of our creators. We don't allow visuals created with generative AI to be included. However, we do allow creators to make limited edits to their original, non‑AI created work, as long as its integrity is preserved (e.g., subject remains the same while removing a trash can from the corner of the shot). Both manual and AI‑powered post‑production tools may be used to make these edits. We don't permit new elements, subjects, or objects to be added to the imagery using AI. All post‑production editing is clearly outlined for our creators. In addition to photography and video, Getty Images offers many forms of visual content, including illustrations, vector art, CGI, 3D visuals, and other images created with the aid of non‑AI computer software. These aren't considered AI‑generated visuals and comply with Getty Images policies.

Visuals generated or modified using Getty Images AI tools are clearly labeled as AI‑generated and are not added back into our Creative or Editorial libraries. Customers can access additional information through Content Credentials and provenance information that explains how the visual was created or modified.

quotes.quote: Stay Ahead of Your Campaigns and Content Demands

Editorial imagery documents real people, places, and events and it’s essential that these images and videos accurately depict news, sports, entertainment, and archival events. That’s why every editorial image and video reflects real‑world subjects captured by a human creator. The use of AI‑based post‑production tools is prohibited in editorial images and videos, except for limited application in staged portraiture. In those cases, AI tools may only be used for retouching that aligns with accepted industry practices and must never alter the factual representation of a person, subject, or scene.
